the design, synthesis, and pharmacological evaluation of new TRP derivatives.
the development of a new class of antidepressant compounds, which could be considered as a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of depression and related disorders.

the antidepressant and sedation activities of the novel synthesized compounds 5, 9, and 12 were more potent than those of the reference drug TRP.
the novel synthesized compounds 9 and12 could be considered as potential antidepressant and sedating agents.

the novel synthesized TRPs 5, 9, and 11a are potent and promising antidepressant and sedatives agents, and may be useful in the treatment of depression and anxiety.
